bulgaria-2011.notes: Pack date 2011-05-15 differs from the 14 May contest day shown on the programme page. The scoreboard has 28 teams against 27 on the teams page (the extra row is named team28). Source 3's page copy has no problem names; the RAR archives are in the website copy (source 1).

sources.evidence: Site headed 'XXIII РЕПУБЛИКАНСКА СТУДЕНТСКА ОЛИМПИАДА ПО ПРОГРАМИРАНЕ - 13-14 май 2011 г.' hosted by Shumen University, with ten pages of this edition including programme, teams, problems and classification.
Classification page with a ranking of 11 universities and a PC^2 scoreboard of 28 team rows, columns Rank, Name, Solved, Time, A to M, Total att/solv.
Problems page with links 'задача A' to 'задача M' for 13 problems; it names no problems and holds no statements itself.

bulgaria-2012.notes: Problem K (БИБЛИОТЕКА, Library) is in the statements PDF, in the ranking columns and in the ZIP; the pack lists 10 problems A-J. Source 5 is a bare solutions and tests archive, so role problemset, not editorial. Source 3 is a duplicate of the home page.

sources.evidence: The home page is headed XXIV Republican Student Olympiad in Programming and says it was held on 12.05.2012 at Burgas Free University, with links to the programme, tasks and ranking.
A 2 page PDF headed Ranking with the official ranking by university followed by a table of 29 team rows with solved, time and per-problem cells.
The copy of the classification address is byte-identical to the 3012-byte home page of the site and holds no standings table.
An 11 page PDF headed XXIV Republican Student Olympiad, 11-12 May 2012, Burgas, with statements for tasks A to K.
The ZIP holds 39 files: source code, input and output files for tasks A to K, with no explanatory text, which makes it material of the problem set and not an editorial.

bulgaria-2013.notes: Source 3 (results.html) has rank, solved and time per university, so I read it as standings, not rankings. TrainingTasks.pdf and CompleteSet.pdf are two near-identical versions of the same 11 problems (a few sample lines differ), so same_as is not set. The registered page ends with an empty team entry.

sources.evidence: The site's home page is headed XXV Jubilee Republican Student Olympiad in Programming, 17-18 May 2013, Sofia, with menu pages for programme, regulations, participants, tasks and ranking.
A PC^2 summary table with 26 team rows, solved, time, per-problem cells for A to K and a totals row.
The table has 14 rows with rank, university, solved tasks and time, which gives solved counts and not only the order.
The page lists registered teams grouped by university, each with its members, under the contest heading.
A 12 page PDF with statements A. Info board to K. Slang and footers XXV Jubilee Republican Student Olympiad, Sofia, 18.05.2013.
A short tasks page headed Tasks of 18.05.2013 whose links lead to two PDFs of problems and to an online judge.
A 12 page PDF with problems A. Info board to K. Slang, footers naming the XXV olympiad, Sofia, 18.05.2013.
